{{nihongo|'''Shibukawa Shrine'''|渋川神社 (八尾市)}} is a shrine in Uematsu-chō, {{ill|Yao, Osaka|ar|ياو (أوساكا)|bcl|Yao, Osaka|be|Яо|bg|Яо|ca|Yao (Osaka)|ce|Яо (Осака)|ceb|Yao-shi|de|Yao (Osaka)|eo|Jao|es|Yao (Osaka)|et|Yao|fa|یائو، اوساکا|fi|Yao|fr|Yao (Osaka)|ga|Yao|gl|Yao|hy|Յաո|id|Yao, Osaka|it|Yao (Osaka)|ja|八尾市|ko|야오시|ms|Yao, Osaka|mzn|یائو، اوساکا|nl|Yao (Osaka)|no|Yao (Osaka)|pl|Yao (miasto)|pt|Yao (Osaka)|ro|Yao (municipiu)|ru|Яо (Япония)|sco|Yao, Osaka|sh|Yao, Osaka|simple|Yao, Osaka|sr|Јао|sv|Yao, Osaka|tg|Яо|th|ยาโอะ|tl|Yao, Osaka|tr|Yao, Osaka|tt|Яо (Осака)|uk|Яо (Осака)|ur|یاو، اوساکا|vi|Yao, Ōsaka|war|Yao, Osaka|zh|八尾市|zh_classical|八尾市|zh_min_nan|Yao-chhī|zh_yue|八尾|qid=Q490872}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} its former rank was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}. {{nihongo|'''Shibukawa Shrine'''|渋川神社 (八尾市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Kawachi Province]].

== History ==
* Enshrined deities are {{ill|Ame-no-oshihomimi|de|Amenooshihomimi|fa|آمه-نو-اوشیهومیمی|fr|Ame-no-oshihomimi|it|Ame-no-oshihomimi|ja|アメノオシホミミ|ko|아메노오시호미미|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯑꯣꯁꯤꯍꯣꯃꯤꯃꯤ|ru|Амэноосихомими но Микото|th|อาเมะ โนะ โอชิโฮมิมิ|uk|Аменоосіхомімі но Мікото|zh|天忍穗耳尊|qid=Q462555|lt=Ame-no-Oshihomimi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Nigihayahi|fr|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|simple|Nigihayahi|zh|饒速日命|qid=Q10949054|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}, Kunisatsuchi-no-Mikoto, Hidaka Ōkami, and Sugawara Ōkami.
* The date of foundation is unknown. It is also said to be the site of the Shibukawa residence of {{ill|Mononobe no Moriya|fa|مونونوبه نو موریا|fr|Mononobe no Moriya|ja|物部守屋|nl|Mononobe no Moriya|pt|Mononobe no Moriya|ru|Мононобэ-но Мория|sh|Mononobe no Moriya|th|โมโนโนเบะ โนะ โมริยะ|uk|Мононобе но Морія|zh|物部守屋|zh_classical|物部守屋|qid=Q2424736}}, whose base was in this area in the Asuka period.
* Originally it stood at Aza Kawamukai east of the old {{ill|Yamato River|arz|نهر ياماتو|ceb|Yamato Gawa|es|Río Yamato|fa|رود یاماتو|fr|Yamato-gawa|gl|Río Yamato|it|Yamato (fiume)|ja|大和川|ko|야마토강|my|ယမတိုမြစ်|ru|Ямато (река)|zh|大和川|qid=Q9001527}}, but a great flood in Tenbun 3 ({{ill|1533|ab|1533|af|1533|als|1533|am|1533 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1533|ar|1533|ary|1533|arz|1533|ast|1533|avk|1533|az|1533|azb|۱۵۳۳ (میلادی)|bar|1533|bcl|1533|be|1533|be_x_old|1533|bg|1533|bn|১৫৩৩|bpy|মারি ১৫৩৩|br|1533|bs|1533.|ca|1533|cdo|1533 nièng|ce|1533 шо|ceb|1533|ckb|١٥٣٣|crh|1533|cs|1533|cv|1533|cy|1533|da|1533|de|1533|diq|1533|el|1533|eml|1533|eo|1533|es|1533|et|1533|eu|1533|fa|۱۵۳۳ (میلادی)|fi|1533|fo|1533|fr|1533|frr|1533|fur|1533|fy|1533|ga|1533|gan|1533年|gcr|1533|gd|1533|gl|1533|gv|1533|he|1533|hi|१५३३|hr|1533.|ht|1533 (almanak jilyen)|hu|1533|hy|1533|ia|1533|id|1533|ilo|1533|io|1533|is|1533|it|1533|ja|1533年|jv|1533|ka|1533|kaa|1533|kk|1533 жыл|ko|1533년|krc|1533 джыл|la|1533|lb|1533|lfn|1533|lij|1533|lmo|1533|lt|1533 m.|lv|1533. gads|mai|१५३३|map_bms|1533|mdf|1533|mg|1533|mhr|1533|mi|1533|min|1533|mk|1533|mr|इ.स. १५३३|mrj|1533 и|ms|1533|my|၁၅၃၃|myv|1533 ие|nah|1533|nap|1533|nds|1533|new|सन् १५३३|nl|1533|nn|1533|no|1533|nrm|1533|nso|1533|oc|1533|olo|1533|or|୧୫୩୩|os|1533-æм аз|pl|1533|pnb|1533|pt|1533|qu|1533|ro|1533|ru|1533 год|rue|1533|sa|१५३३|sah|1533|sc|1533|scn|1533|sd|1533ع|se|1533|sh|1533.|shn|1533|simple|1533|sk|1533|sl|1533|smn|1533|sq|1533|sr|1533|su|1533|sv|1533|sw|1533|ta|1533|te|1533|tg|Соли 1533|th|พ.ศ. 2076|tk|1533|tl|1533|tly|1533|tr|1533|tt|1533 ел|uk|1533|ur|1533ء|uz|1533|vec|1533|vi|1533|vls|1533|wa|1533|war|1533|wuu|1533年|xmf|1533|yi|1533|zh|1533年|zh_min_nan|1533 nî|zh_yue|1533年|qid=Q6443}}) washed away the entire precinct. At that time, Ukishima Shrine drifted to Nitta Village in Matta District, several kilometers north. * In the precinct stand several large trees, including the Osaka Prefecture natural monument {{ill|Camphora officinarum|Q158722|qid=Q158722}}.

== Festivals ==
* Summer festival (July 25-26): commonly called the “reverse festival.” When the shrine was swept away by flood in the past, the sacred object reportedly flowed upstream against the current, giving rise to the name.

== Access ==
* About 5 minutes on foot from {{ill|Yao Station|Q856485|qid=Q856485}} on JR {{ill|Yamatoji Line|Q1151659|qid=Q1151659}}. It is located just south of the station.
